items.title: Keeping our unhoused community warm this winter
items.author: The editorial team
items.excerpt: On October 23, Paul St-Pierre Plamondon released plans to fulfill his first campaign promise as Premier: allocating an additional 28 million dollars to the 48 million provincial budget to operate warming shelters for unhoused people this winter. Around 16 to 18 million dollars
items.imageCredit: Photo : illuminatusds / CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
items.leadExcerpt: Investing in warming shelters is not enough, as shelters and homes are not synonymous. This distinction is especially pertinent for “situational” or “hidden homelessness,” where people seek shelter in their vehicles, hotels, and other forms of temporary housing. Nonetheless, some individuals find themselves in the visible category of being unhoused, falling under cyclical or chronic subtypes.
